cp17:1.1: Punāparaṃ yadā homi jaṭilo uggatāpano Mātaṅgo nāma nāmena sīlavā susamāhito, || ||
cp17:2.1: Ahañca brāhmaṇo eko Gaṅgākūle vasām' ubho; ahaṃ vasāmi upari heṭṭhā vasati brāhmaṇo. || ||
cp17:3.1: Vicaranto anukūlamhi uddhaṃ me assama' ddasa tattha maṃ paribhāsitvā abhisapi muddhaphālanaṃ. || ||
cp17:4.1: Yadi' haṃ tassa pakuppeyyaṃ yadi sīlaṃ na gopaye oloketvāna' haṃ tassa kareyyaṃ chārikaṃ viya. || ||
cp17:5.1: Yaṃ so tadā maṃ abhisapi kupito duṭṭhamānaso tass' eva matthake nipati; yogena taṃ pamocayiṃ. || ||
cp17:6.1: Anurakkhiṃ mama sīlaṃ nārakkhiṃ mama jīvitaṃ sīlavā hi tadā āsiṃ bodhiyā-yeva kāraṇā 'ti. || ||
